summary: Mitis was a Nomai from Brittle Hollow who lived in the Hanging City. Mitis took the position in the Ash Twin Project warp-core debate that the Nomai should relearn how to make an advanced warp core rather than try to recover the Vessel's old one.

location: Mitis lived in the Hanging City on Brittle Hollow.
lore: Mitis participated in the Ash Twin Project warp-core discussion.
Mitis acknowledged Spire's argument that abandoning the Vessel's warp core meant losing valuable knowledge.
Mitis argued the Nomai had little hope of recovering the Vessel's knowledge and should relearn how to make an advanced warp core instead.
